findings.text: the landing record (and the same sentence at docs/plans/the-fleet-counters-count-the-fleet.html:175) says the arrow sat on column 85 at 971d4889 with _display_state eliding every state word, but at that revision the arrow sits on column 107 and no classifier word is elided to the cell (STATE_WORD=22, the widest word), so the record's reproduction reasoning is false for its base revision; the actionable conclusion survives, but a coordinator correcting the followup from this record would be working from a false history.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit; c9a2ff4b moves the seven test files onto the compressed row (counter block, role elision, clause cuts, the long-state guard at tests/test_ticker_reads_cleanly.py:181) and 39f4c96f appends the plan paragraph and the evidence anchor, with no product code changed.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks that the nine assigned files add no failures at 971d4889 and at head, that the long-state test hold the arrow and be red at 5ef9ee49, and that the manifest name each file changed; the recorded arms (259 passed at head, 26 failed / 233 passed for the same files on 971d4889) assert the first and third, the red-at-5ef9ee49 clause is unmeetable because reckon/crew/ticker.py is blob 7ea78c4b at both 5ef9ee49 and head, and the node recorded that falsification plus a mutation control that reddens the guard.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to bring the seven test files pinning the retired row geometry onto the compressed row and to keep a long state word's arrow on one column; tests/test_ticker_reads_cleanly.py:181 carries the long-state guard, and I measured all 56 classifier-word rows on one arrow column at the reviewed head.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, 259 passed at head, 26 failed / 233 passed at 971d4889 and the negative control, but its follow_parallels repeats the landing record's column-85-at-971d4889 claim that my own measurement contradicts.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares thirteen paths; the two commits touch nine files (seven tests, two docs; git diff --stat 5ef9ee49..39f4c96f) and none outside the declared set, with reckon/crew/ticker.py declared but untouched.

justifications.durability: the guard at tests/test_ticker_reads_cleanly.py:181 reddens when the elision is removed (my in-process control moves 5 of 56 rows at the reviewed head) and its cell-content and non-empty-head assertions are what catch a to_state widening the left-aligned destination cell cannot move the arrow for.
justifications.evidence: the head arm, the base arm and the mutation control are logged and reproducible (test_logs under this run's directory) while the landing record's own reproduction table at docs/evidence/archive/the-fleet-counters-count-the-fleet-landed.html:316 asserts an arrow column at 971d4889 that no render at that revision produces.
justifications.fit: the added pins read the renderer's own constants and display helpers rather than literals, the test names state the mechanism, and ruff check and ruff format --check pass clean on all seven changed files.
justifications.goal_fidelity: both halves of the goal hold at the reviewed head (every classifier word elided to STATE_WORD=10 at reckon/crew/ticker.py:208, the arrow on one column), the second by the base's own geometry and now guarded rather than reimplemented.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff (git diff --stat 5ef9ee49..39f4c96f) is inside the manifest's thirteen declared write paths, and the two non-geometric pin repairs are named in the manifest's failure_attribution.
